opener_episode.title: #435 - #1 Censored Radio Host: Iran War, Kash Patel & What Broke Howard Stern
opener_episode.why: Most recent personality-driven (not science/conspiracy) episode; a Florida media figure telling insider stories about fame, money and celebrity feuds is the closest tonal match to Avery's Miami celebrity-art stories. Back up the opener by citing the show's proven art-world appetite: #346 'The $450 Million Da Vinci Conspiracy & CIA Psyops Behind Modern Art' (Giampiero Ambrosi; forger Tony Tetro) - episode existence from prior research via Apple Podcasts listing, not re-confirmed in this pass.

angles.headline: From a prison badge to the blockchain: the wildest objects the NFT boom sold
angles.pitch: Avery's ArtGrails sold Michael Cohen's prison badge as an NFT (Vanity Fair, 2021) and dropped work with Ozuna (Rolling Stone), an insider's account of how the NFT-era money machine actually ran and who bought what.
angles.builds_on: Show's appetite for hidden-world money stories (#436 Grillo, #346 Da Vinci/CIA art episode)

angles.headline: Fame, money and outlandish requests: what celebrities really ask their art dealer
angles.pitch: Avery advises celebrities, athletes and HNW buyers; he placed a $100K+ Hap Tivey with Kris Jenner at Art Basel Miami Beach 2024 (Us Weekly) and sold Scott Disick a $57K Helmut Newton print (Page Six), and can tell the behind-the-curtain stories of how stars buy art.
angles.builds_on: #435 Bubba The Love Sponge (celebrity feuds, insider media stories)

angles.headline: How a street artist became a global brand, and a War Dogs story on the side
angles.pitch: Avery turned Alec Monopoly from street artist into a global brand with sold-out shows from New York to Morocco, built ArtLife into an eight-figure online gallery, and has interviewed War Dogs' David Packouz and Kenny Schachter on his own show, a long-form rags-to-riches arc from the fringes of the art world.
angles.builds_on: Show's mission of bringing fringe cultures to a wider audience via long-form storytelling (Tampa Bay Chronicle profile)
